objective: Stop unbounded backward paper recursion, make optional sources opt-in in the reader UI, and build only the missing ODE/phase-plane concept rung needed to execute the Shin-McKay source.

policy.shared_floor: smallest reusable concept articles needed to execute the branch
policy.domain_floor: at most one canonical source per causal branch
policy.current_layer: concept plus at most one current evidence source when it changes a decision
promotion_mandatory: unique premise required by the hardest problem
claim/evidence boundary too important for a short citation
stop_conditions: older source adds provenance but no executable premise
premise already exists in the shared or domain floor
hardest problem is solvable without another reconstruction
source only explains historical naming or equation origin
source exceeds budget without a capability-based exception

reader_visibility.source_articles: collapsed in listings; direct routes and search remain
reader_visibility.lineage_only: not present in the default public list

blocked_operations: convert second-order motion to a state trajectory
separate numerical error from physical-model error
top_down_ladder.gap: No article explained how a local rate rule plus an initial or boundary state becomes a numerical trajectory.
top_down_ladder.stop_reason: The reader can now reconstruct forward/backward state integration and switching without historical ODE papers.

private_transfer_gate.scenario: Audit a nonlinear robot retiming implementation that combines adaptive forward integration, backward terminal integration, torque-derived acceleration bounds, event detection and a fixed-step Euler fallback.
required_diagnoses: explain why position alone is insufficient for second-order motion
explain why forward acceleration can miss terminal speed
interpret backward integration physically and numerically
predict switching changes under asymmetric accel/brake
detect interval violations between passing endpoints
separate step size, tolerance, event and model failures
reject solver success as validation of units or dynamics
private_transfer_gate.publication_policy: The scenario remains private; public intuition, derivations and labs provide the transferable insight.

events.observed: Each foundational paper generated more predecessor paper cards and no obvious place to stop.
events.inference: Chronology was overriding reader capability and increasing confusion.
events.decision: Introduce a per-branch foundation floor, source budget, promotion gate and capability-based stop test.
events.verification: The policy and authoring protocols now require the floor record before source discovery.

events.observed: Optional source cards appeared alongside required concepts in category lists.
events.inference: Readers could not distinguish the core route from evidence deep dives.
events.decision: Keep concepts visible and collapse paper/research/reference routes behind explicit controls.
events.verification: Foundations, NLP, RL and Robotics pass closed-then-open visibility tests at 390 and 1440 pixels.

events.observed: Shin-McKay used raw-looking path-dynamics terms and jumped from substitution to switching curves.
events.inference: The source reconstruction named operations but did not give the state-integration insight needed to follow them.
events.decision: Rewrite the thesis and mechanism in fixed-path, progress, allowed-acceleration, forward-accel, backward-brake and meeting-point order.
events.verification: The page renders q=q(s), s=s(t), projected dynamics and acceleration bounds with KaTeX and plain Korean explanations.

events.observed: A four-column source reconstruction compressed text and hid execution order.
events.inference: The flow was technically present but not scannable.
events.decision: Use responsive numbered two-column reconstruction cards with optional KaTeX.
events.verification: The reconstruction is readable at 390 and 1440 pixels without overflow.

events.observed: Calculus and optimization did not teach trajectory integration, phase-plane state or boundary meeting.
events.inference: A reusable concept gap, not a missing historical paper, blocked the canonical source.
events.decision: Create one ODE/phase-plane/numerical-integration article and link it into Math & Science and the Shin ladder.
events.verification: Six formulas, six notes and four causal labs cover the blocked operations and explicitly return to Shin-McKay.

events.observed: Eight old regression tests still required source cards to be immediately visible.
events.inference: The old assertions contradicted the new intended UX.
events.decision: Assert concept visible, source hidden by default and source visible after explicit expansion.
events.verification: Affected 8/8 tests and complete 100/100 local regression passed.

events.observed: A refreshed public page could still serve an older bundle if the service was not restarted.
events.decision: Restart the service, verify seven routes with curl and run public-host Playwright.
events.verification: All routes HTTP 200 and public focused suite 32/32.

qa.typescript: pre-existing unrelated diagnostics remain; no ODE, floor, category or Shin change appears in the reported errors
qa.deployment: cm-blog.service active after restart at 22:49 KST; all target routes HTTP 200
